title: Two-story house over a garage and accessory unit
source: Design progress deck: site plan, first and second floor plans, four elevations and a section (for reference, not for construction).

stages.label: House
stages.line: The finished house: a two-story house with an accessory unit and garage below and the main home above, all under one shed roof that rises toward the deck side. Choose Explore to turn the model or go to a room.

stages.label: Deck side
stages.line: The deck side: a 5 foot deck along the second floor with its entry doors, a row of clerestory windows under the high eave, and a walkway along the unit below.

stages.label: Roof
stages.line: The roof lifts away: one low-slope shed roof over the whole house, high on the deck side with a 7 foot overhang over the deck.

stages.label: Second floor
stages.line: The second floor home: two bedrooms and a shared bath across the front, a powder room and closets, and an open kitchen, dining and living room under a sloped ceiling.

stages.label: First floor
stages.line: The first floor: a one-bedroom accessory unit with a kitchen and living room, bath and corridor, beside a two-car garage with laundry and mechanical space.

stages.label: Floor
stages.line: The first floor deck on a site that falls about three and a half feet toward the deck side.

sheetLabel: Static plan of the first floor of a two-story house over a garage and accessory unit.
assumptions: The source is a design progress deck marked for reference, not for construction; the design may still change.
The plans are images, not drawings to scale: walls and openings are scaled from them using the printed overall dimensions, so positions may be off by a few inches.
Window and door heights are scaled from the elevations; window sizes are not printed.
The roof pitch (about 3 in 12) and the north and south overhangs are scaled from the section and elevations; the east and west overhangs are printed.
The ground is drawn as a plane from the printed grade 3 feet 6 inches below the first floor on the deck side up to about floor level at the garage side; the plans do not give spot grades.
The second floor bath opens to both bedrooms; the door types there are not legible and are drawn as plain openings.
Closet walls on the second floor are drawn 8 feet tall; the bath and linen walls run up to the sloped ceiling as the section shows.
Deck stair guards and the dog gates are not drawn; the deck guards are drawn as horizontal bars, as the elevations show.
